summary: All 8 acceptance criteria exercised: 11/11 backend pytest cases passed, 7/7 browser checks passed.

checks.criterion: Admin login works and protects admin routes
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_auth.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login admin/admin123 -> 200 + ads_session cookie; GET /api/sites without cookie -> 401; with cookie -> 200 list; wrong password -> 401

checks.criterion: Admin login works and protects admin routes
checks.name: admin-login-protects-routes
checks.evidence: /admin without session redirects to admin-login-form; login with admin/admin123 lands on 'Siteler & Domainler' heading

checks.name: no-tuna-text-in-ui
checks.evidence: Case-insensitive body-text scan for 'tuna' returned none on /?site=marco, admin sites list, add-site dialog, library page, and site editor

checks.criterion: Site create / update / duplicate / set-default / delete all work
checks.name: test_tscheck_site_crud.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/sites -> 201; PUT /api/sites/{id} title/columns persisted on refetch; POST /set-default -> is_default true; POST /duplicate -> 201 clone; DELETE -> 200, then GET -> 404; duplicate slug create -> 409

checks.criterion: Site create / update / duplicate / set-default / delete all work
checks.name: site-create-update-duplicate-delete-ui
checks.evidence: Yeni Site dialog created tscheck card; editor title change persisted after reload; star button showed 'VARSAYILAN TASARIM' badge; duplicate dialog cloned site; both delete buttons removed cards. Restored marco as default afterward (hygiene) since set-default is a single global flag.

checks.criterion: Ad slot (reklam alanı) CRUD + ordering inside site editor
checks.name: test_tscheck_adslot_crud.py
checks.evidence: POST /slots x2 -> 201; PUT slot fields (badge/text_size/effect/col_span) persisted on refetch; POST /slots/reorder reordered ids; DELETE slot -> 200 and removed from list

checks.criterion: Ad slot (reklam alanı) CRUD + ordering inside site editor
checks.name: adslot-crud-ordering-ui
checks.evidence: Added 2 image slots in editor; edited title/badge/target url; moved first slot down; reload confirmed new order and persisted badge/target values

checks.criterion: Logo upload accepts GIF up to 10MB
checks.name: test_tscheck_upload_gif.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/uploads with image/gif -> 200 {url}; GET url -> 200 content-type image/gif matching bytes; POST with text/plain -> 400

checks.criterion: Library page and logo picker dialog
checks.name: library-and-logo-picker-ui
checks.evidence: Uploaded a GIF via Kütüphane file input, item appeared in grid; opened logo picker in a fixture slot editor, selected the uploaded item, preview showed image and backend slot.image_url was non-empty

checks.criterion: Visitor portal renders per-domain config, popup and clicks
checks.name: test_tscheck_public_portal.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/public/site?slug=<tscheck> -> 200 with site+slots; POST /api/public/slots/{id}/click -> 200 {ok:true}; slot.clicks incremented to 1; unknown slug still 200 (documented fallback)

checks.criterion: Visitor portal renders per-domain config, popup and clicks
checks.name: visitor-portal-popup-and-click
checks.evidence: /?site=marco shows welcome-popup-modal, closable via popup-close-button; clicking an ad card fired POST /api/public/slots/{id}/click with <300 status; /?site=deniz23 vs /?site=marco render distinct portal-logo text

checks.name: test_tscheck_stats_link_health.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/sites/{id}/stats?days=7 -> 200 with daily[7] + slots incl. total_clicks>=1; POST /api/sites/{id}/slots/check-links -> 200 with results for created slot

checks.name: stats-panel-renders
checks.evidence: İstatistikler tab renders stats-daily-chart, stats-total-clicks showing '1', stats-slot-row; no pageerror console exceptions

notes: Stats endpoint lives at GET /api/sites/{site_id}/stats (admin-auth'd), not /api/stats/{site_id} as briefing text suggested; verified via the actual router and exercised accordingly.
Backend probe and frontend probe both returned 200 before testing began.
set-default is a single global flag (only one site can be default); the site-CRUD browser check restores the original seeded default (marco) at the end so other criteria/tests are unaffected.
